name: Phase 12 Contention Staleness Diagnostic
description: Replicates the known E-core ratio-0.500/M multistable STAGED fixture with bounded per-core contention freshness and idle-streak telemetry.

sweeps.description: The single known multistable fixture: eight E-core workers, four productive parallel handles, M body, and fixed STAGED execution.

trials.name: STAGED E-Core Phase 12 Base
trials.description: Uses the unchanged Phase 10/11 E-core topology, idle policy, decision weights, JVM settings, source type, and deterministic body workload.
trials.hypothesis: If stale contention sustains the high attractor, high-state forks will show longer idle streaks and materially older or sparser contention observations than low-state forks.
